Title: Senior Manager, Insights & Analytics, GOC
Description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. Role Summary And Impact As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Manager who will: Report directly to the VP of Investment & Partnerships, connecting media investment strategy with business intelligence and owning the end-to-end data workflow for partner spend forecasting, tracking, and performance validation. Extract, analyze, and validate spend forecasts from CoreM, WPP Media’s proprietary client spend forecasting dashboard. Gather and consolidate forecasts across Agency Client Teams, MM&D Solutions, and MM&D Activation, covering programmatic, social, advanced TV, linear TV, radio, out-of-home, and print. Build and maintain unified reporting models that combine CoreM forecasts with agency, Solutions, and Activation data across deal and non-deal partners. Produce recurring deal-partner spend pacing reports, identifying trends, risks, and potential shortfalls that could affect trading commitments. Extract spend pacing data from MediaOcean and reconcile it with vendor delivery data to monitor partner performance. Investigate and resolve discrepancies between forecasted spend and actual delivery, collaborating with vendors and agency teams to ensure accurate reporting. Use Canadian market intelligence sources, including nLogic Lens, Comscore, CRTC, and Guideline, to validate investment decisions and contextualize performance. Develop data-backed presentations and supporting materials for publisher negotiations and strategic partnership reviews. Identify opportunities to automate data collection and reporting, improving operational efficiency, consistency, and data quality. Collaborate closely with agency teams, Solutions and Activation specialists, and external media partners to communicate findings and support investment decisions. Skills And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field. 3–5 years of professional experience in media planning, media buying, investment, or analytics. Deep understanding of the Canadian media landscape, including regulators, publishers, and vendor ecosystems. Experience with media investment and measurement tools such as MediaOcean/Prisma, nLogic Lens and FT, Comscore, and Airware. Advanced Excel proficiency, including nested formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data modeling. Experience using Tableau and/or Power BI to develop dashboards and communicate findings. Basic knowledge of SQL is a plus. Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Excellent attention to detail and data quality assurance skills, particularly when validating forecasts, reconciling delivery data, and investigating discrepancies. Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple reporting requirements and meet deadlines. Effective communication and relationship-building skills for collaborating with agency teams, internal stakeholders, and external media partners. A proactive approach to identifying anomalies, investigating their causes, and improving reporting processes. Title: Data Engineer
Description: Job Description About Ford and ATP Ford Motor Company has endured and thrived for more than 118 years by reimagining how things are built. Today, Ford is leading a once-in-a-generation transformation in manufacturing — scaling EVs, integrating humanoid robotics, additive manufacturing, AI vision, and digital platforms into one seamless operating system: the Ford Production System (FPS/FPS+) that operates within the FAST framework. Ford Motor Company is undergoing a historic industrial shift — from building great vehicles to building great systems that scale across them. The Advanced Industrial Technology & Platforms (AITP) organisation was created to operationalise that shift. Our job is not to deploy isolated tools; it is to build a system that learns from factory truth, transforms it into scalable platforms, and turns those platforms into enterprise business value. Advanced Industrial Technology and Platforms (ATP) is a new, centralised organisation designed to position Ford to lead industrial innovation. This team will accelerate our digital evolution and manufacturing excellence — advancing the modernisation of our Ford Manufacturing operations with cutting-edge technology. As part of Ford Manufacturing, ATP is designed to integrate directly into our manufacturing sites, partner across teams (GME, safety, etc.) and drive innovation from initial idea to full implementation. ATP is led by Managing Director Yung Fung, reporting to Ford Chief Manufacturing Officer Bryce Currie. This structure includes four vertical business units — focused on specific technology stacks — and four horizontals — shared services designed to ensure scale, deployment, and operational consistency. As part of the AITP organisation, the Sight Vertical is responsible for building an end-to-end business around AI/ML anomaly detection products, operating as two product families. Sight.Sense detects anomalies in parametric data: Sense.Machine ( MiniTerms ) for machine performance anomaly prediction and optimisation; Sense.Tooling (AI ToolSense ) for tooling life optimisation; Sense.Energy for optimisation of supplies consumption; Sense.Stamping for stamping process anomaly prediction and surface splits; and Sense.MILO for in-process test quality anomaly detection. Sight.Vision detects anomalies in image data: Vision.Scout for in-station visual error proofing across manual and automated processes; Vision.Surface for surface defect detection in components and vehicle bodies through the complete manufacturing process; and Vision.Station for manual process monitoring and anomaly detection covering productivity, quality and ergonomics. The Sight Vertical product portfolio are set to converge on the Sight Anomaly Platform, which builds on Ford's Core Systems layer (Core OS, CoreDS , Core AI and CoreApps /FPS+). Together they form Ford's scalable platform to deliver, process quality assurance, and zero-downtime, zero-defect manufacturing. How The Sight Vertical Works The Sight Vertical operates through value-focused, cross-functional product teams across two product families: Sight.Sense and Sight.Vision , each led by a Head of Product Family. Product Managers lead the product problem, desired outcome and priority. Engineers and product designers work with them to discover and deliver effective solutions. Engineering Managers retain people, capacity, technical-system and engineering-health accountability. This is a vertical-level role working across both product families. Priorities are agreed between the two Heads of Product and their Engineering Managers, so that your effort is directed by portfolio value. In addition, ATP Core provides the non-product engineering expertise the verticals depend on — enterprise standards, architecture, industrial controls, cybersecurity and platform guidance. This role holds a matrix reporting line into ATP Core to ensure alignment with those standards and ready access to that expertise. The Opportunity We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and operate the data foundations of the Sight portfolio — the pipelines that carry factory truth from PLCs, sensors, cameras and plant systems into a platform where anomalies can be detected reliably, at scale, across Ford's global manufacturing footprint. Sight data is genuinely hard: tens of thousands of monitored assets, billions of waveforms annually, high-volume image and video data from Vision.Scout , Vision.Surface and Vision.Station , event-driven and polled sources, mixed plant infrastructure, and legacy equipment that was never designed to be observed. Getting this right is what makes the models trustworthy — and model trust is what determines whether plants act on our products or ignore them. You will work at the intersection of operational technology, cloud data engineering and machine learning enablement, across both parametric data and image-based detection. This is a senior individual contributor role. As the senior data engineering voice in the Sight Vertical, you will set the data engineering standards others work to, mentor engineers working with Sight data, and be accountable for ensuring the data foundations do not depend on you personally to remain trustworthy. The Position You will report into the Sight Vertical Director, with a matrix reporting line into the ATP Core team. The Sight Vertical Director leads what you prioritise and holds performance and development accountability; ATP Core provides technical alignment, enterprise standards and access to non-product expertise. Working embedded within product streams across both families, you will partner with the Software Architect, Controls Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineers, data scientists, the Launch and Deployment Engineers and plant controls teams. You will provide technical direction and mentorship to engineers on data-related work. This is a senior individual contributor position with indirect leadership expectations. You will work primarily on Google Cloud Platform, Ford's strategic cloud platform, and engage with CoreDS and Core AI as the strategic data and ML platform direction for the Sight Vertical. Requires availability to travel internationally on occasion to understand plant data sources at source. Responsibilities 4 Days On Site In GTBC FORD México (Naucalpan, México) Able to travel periodically to Europe and US. Build and Operate Data Pipelines Design, build, test and operate reliable ingestion and processing pipelines from plant OT sources — PLC event data, sensor streams, waveform captures, energy meters and image capture — into GCP. Work with both event-driven ('notifier') and polled ('questioner') acquisition models, adapting to plant-level infrastructure choices such as CrossPLC (Ford developed middleware), Node-RED, DeviceWise, HiveMQ. Build batch and streaming pipelines on GCP — Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run/Functions, Cloud Composer, BigQuery and Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL — with infrastructure and pipelines defined as code. Handle high-volume unstructured image and video data for Vision products, including object storage design, lifecycle and cost management, frame sampling and metadata indexing. Own pipelines through production operation: monitoring, alerting, cost, backfill, recovery and incident response. Data Modelling, Quality and Semantics Design and maintain data models and semantic layers that make anomaly detection data usable across products and plants — including the common data model that enables global interoperability and rapid replication. Implement data quality controls: validation, completeness, drift, latency and lineage — and make data health visible rather than assumed. Model plant, line, station, asset and tool hierarchies consistently across both product families, integrating with systems of record such as Maximo. Optimise storage, partitioning and query performance and cost in BigQuery. Define and design data set lifecycle, historical, archiving, and purging approaches. Enabling Analytics and Machine Learning Prepare and serve training and inference datasets for parametric and image-based anomaly detection models, including labelling and annotation workflows, dataset versioning and feature availability. Partner with data scientists on the MLOps path to production — reproducible datasets, versioning, monitoring and retraining triggers. Support edge inference requirements, ensuring data available on the machine matches what models were trained on. Build the datasets behind value evidence and dashboards used by plants, Product Managers and the ATP ledger. Governance, Security and Engineering Practice Apply Ford data governance, privacy, retention and cybersecurity requirements across OT and IT boundaries, working with the Controls Engineer where plant-floor constraints apply. Give particular attention to imagery of people, where Vision.Station monitors manual processes and ergonomics — applying privacy, consent, retention and works council requirements with HR, Legal and local plant leadership. Manage access and identity appropriately for plant, product and enterprise consumers of Sight data. Define and own reusable ingestion and onboarding patterns so adding a plant is configuration rather than a project. Set data engineering standards for the vertical — pipeline design, testing, documentation, naming, lineage and runbook expectations — and hold work to them through review. Mentor and coach engineers working with Sight data, pairing on complex pipeline and modelling problems and explaining trade-offs rather than simply supplying answers. Actively reduce single-person dependency on critical datasets and pipelines, ensuring at least one other engineer can maintain each of them. Lead technical design for significant data platform changes, producing options, trade-offs and architecture decision records with the Software Architect. Qualifications Functional & Technical Knowledge Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrable experience. Typically 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with a substantial track record of production pipelines and data platforms you have designed, built and operated at scale. Advanced SQL and strong Python, with the judgement to choose appropriate tools and patterns rather than defaulting to the familiar. Practical experience with a major cloud data platform — GCP required (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Composer). Experience with batch and streaming data processing and with orchestration tooling. Experience of data modelling for analytical and operational use, and of data quality and validation practice. Software engineering fundamentals: version control, automated testing, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), infrastructure as code. Ability to work with imperfect, real-world industrial data and to trace problems back to source. Demonstrable experience mentoring and growing other engineers — pairing, design and code review, technical coaching and knowledge transfer. Ability to lead complex technical work end to end under ambiguity, and to communicate data trade-offs clearly to product, plant and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent professional English. Team player, problem solver, agile way of working. Preferred Requirements Experience with time-series, high-frequency sensor or waveform data at scale. Experience with unstructured image or video data at scale, including annotation pipelines and dataset versioning for computer vision models. Experience with industrial and OT data sources — PLC tag data, OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus, historians, SCADA, energy metering. Experience supporting ML workloads and MLOps (Vertex AI, Keras/TensorFlow, feature stores, model monitoring). Experience with dbt, Dataform, Terraform or equivalent transformation and infrastructure-as-code tooling. Familiarity with data governance and cataloguing in a large enterprise, and with OT/IT security segregation. Experience of data privacy requirements where imagery or video of people is processed. Experience acting as the senior or lead data engineer in a team, setting standards and owning a data platform's direction. Exposure to manufacturing systems (Maximo, MES, GDPS 2.0) or automotive and other high-complexity manufacturing. Additional European language (Spanish or German). Success in Role Sight data pipelines are reliable, monitored, documented and cost-effective, with data quality visibly managed. Onboarding a new plant or asset group to the data platform becomes a configuration exercise, not a bespoke build. Data scientists and engineers can access trustworthy, reproducible datasets without bespoke intervention. A consistent common data model and asset hierarchy is in place across Sight products, supporting global replication. Model performance is supported by demonstrable data lineage, labelling quality and drift monitoring. Data governance, access control, privacy and cybersecurity requirements are met across OT and IT boundaries. Data engineering standards and patterns you have defined are visibly used by other engineers across both product families. Engineers you mentor demonstrably grow in autonomy and quality on data work; you are not a permanent bottleneck. No critical dataset or pipeline depends on a single person. This role sits at the intersection of product, finance, data, and external partner management, requiring someone who can translate complex data into actionable strategy, influence partners and regulators without formal authority, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Design financial models, unit economics frameworks, and attribution methodologies to evaluate program sustainability and inform funding decisions. Identify and execute automation opportunities that eliminate manual operational burden across Finance, Accounting, Product, and FinOps teams. Monitor and recover key payment metrics (PSR, ASR, Share of Wallet) via root cause analysis, transaction-level diagnostics, and cross-company coordination. Translate complex data into stakeholder-compelling narratives for senior leadership, supporting WBR/MBR/QBR cycles and strategic planning (OP1/OP2). Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Finance, BI, and external partners to deliver against the Amazon Access roadmap. You design the financial architecture behind a rewards program, model its unit economics, and present the go/no-go recommendation to leadership. You write SQL to uncover why acquisition spiked during a High Value Event, then turn that insight into the strategy for the next one. No two days look the same because you own the full spectrum - from regulatory influence and partner negotiation to data analysis and automation design. This is a role where analytical rigor directly translates into business impact at scale, and where you operate with the autonomy of a founder inside one of the world's most customer-obsessed companies. Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
Description: Acerca de PayJoy PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible. Acerca del rol El Commercial Excellence Analyst existe para garantizar la excelencia operativa y comercial en la red de tiendas de PayJoy México. Este rol es crítico para proteger la rentabilidad del negocio mediante el control riguroso de inventarios, precios, materiales promocionales y métricas de riesgo crediticio (FPD) en cada punto de venta. Al asegurar la consistencia en la ejecución de los KPIs clave, esta posición reduce la variabilidad entre tiendas, previene pérdidas por desbalances de inventario o precios incorrectos, y proporciona visibilidad oportuna para detectar y corregir desviaciones antes de que impacten el negocio. Responsabilidades Control de inventario en tienda: Monitorear y auditar de manera regular los niveles de inventario de equipos celulares en cada punto de venta, identificando situaciones de sobrestock o desabasto, y coordinando acciones correctivas con los equipos de supply chain y operaciones para mantener niveles óptimos que soporten las metas de venta sin generar capital inmovilizado. Supervisión de precios de equipos: Verificar que los precios de los equipos celulares en tienda sean consistentes con la política comercial vigente, detectando y escalando discrepancias que puedan erosionar márgenes o generar confusión en el cliente, asegurando una ejecución correcta de actualizaciones de precios en todos los puntos de venta de la red. Gestión de materiales y activaciones promocionales: Asegurar que las tiendas cuenten con los materiales promocionales correctos y actualizados (POP, señalética, fichas de producto), coordinando su distribución oportuna y verificando en campo que las promociones vigentes estén correctamente exhibidas y comunicadas al equipo de ventas para garantizar una ejecución impecable en el piso. Seguimiento y control de métricas FPD/Riesgo: Recopilar, analizar y reportar los indicadores de First Payment Default (FPD) y otras métricas de riesgo crediticio por tienda, identificando patrones o tiendas con comportamiento atípico, y colaborando con los equipos de riesgo y operaciones para implementar acciones correctivas que mejoren la calidad de la cartera originada en punto de venta. Monitoreo del cumplimiento de KPIs por tienda: Dar seguimiento periódico a los KPIs comerciales y operativos clave de cada tienda (conversión, ticket promedio, colocación, inventario, cumplimiento de precios, entre otros), generando reportes de desempeño que permitan identificar brechas, reconocer mejores prácticas y proponer planes de acción para elevar el estándar de ejecución en toda la red. Visitas de campo y auditorías operativas: Realizar visitas regulares a tiendas para auditar in situ la correcta ejecución de los lineamientos comerciales, recopilar hallazgos en formato estructurado, y brindar retroalimentación directa a los equipos de tienda para reforzar el cumplimiento de los estándares operativos de PayJoy. Generación de reportes e insights accionables: Consolidar la información de inventario, precios, promociones, FPD y KPIs en dashboards o reportes ejecutivos periódicos dirigidos a la gerencia comercial y de operaciones, facilitando la toma de decisiones oportuna y el seguimiento de iniciativas de mejora a nivel red de tiendas. Colaboración transversal con equipos internos: Actuar como enlace entre los equipos de tienda, supply chain, marketing, riesgo y finanzas para asegurar que los procesos comerciales y operativos se ejecuten de manera coordinada, resolviendo blockers operativos y escalando oportunamente situaciones que requieran atención de otras áreas del negocio. Requisitos Educación: Licenciatura concluida en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Mercadotecnia, Contabilidad o carrera afín. Experiencia: 2 años de experiencia en roles de operaciones, control de inventarios, auditoría de proyectos o análisis de KPIs operativos/financieros. Dominio de herramientas de análisis de datos: Nivel intermedio en Excel o Google Sheets (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas). Capacidad de interpretar y presentar datos de manera clara. Idioma: Español nativo; inglés nivel básico-intermedio (capacidad de leer reportes y comunicarse por escrito con equipos regionales) Disponibilidad para trabajo de campo: Disposición para realizar visitas a tiendas en la zona asignada dentro de México, con posibilidad de viajes ocasionales a nivel nacional. Title: AI & Transformation Manager, Customer Success
Description: Descripción de la empresa En Doctoralia , nuestra misión es humanizar la experiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología. Como la plataforma líder en el mercado mexicano y referente global en soluciones SaaS para el sector médico, conectamos a millones de pacientes con especialistas, transformando la práctica clínica en una experiencia digital eficiente y centrada en el paciente. La misión El/la AI & Transformation Manager es dueño del modelo operativo de Customer Success en Doctoralia México: define cómo se atiende al doctor a lo largo de su ciclo de vida —activación, adopción, farming, upsell y churn— y decide, journey por journey, qué resuelve un agente automatizado, qué se queda en manos de una persona y por qué. Su razón de ser es cambiar la relación entre el tamaño de la cartera y el tamaño del equipo: que atender a más doctores deje de exigir proporcionalmente más gente, sin degradar la calidad de la relación con el doctor. Responde por el resultado en retención y en costo de servir , no por la cantidad de herramientas lanzadas. Su marco de actuación es la operación de CS México y los sistemas que la ejecutan. Colabora con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations, el equipo de venta de productos adicionales, los Key Account Managers y los equipos globales del grupo. No es un rol de ciencia de datos: no entrena modelos, construye y opera los sistemas con los que trabaja el área. Lo que harás Modelo operativo: mapear el ciclo de vida del doctor y decidir, journey por journey, qué resuelve la IA en primera instancia y qué escala a una persona. Rediseño de journeys: reconstruir onboarding, farming, upsell y churn alrededor de agentes, con puntos de intervención humana definidos de forma explícita. Mejora continua: el modelo nunca está terminado — actualizarlo conforme cambian producto, herramientas y mercado, y retirar lo que deja de servir. Causas raíz de churn: atacar falla de pago, onboarding fallido y flujos de churn rotos rediseñando el journey, usando la señal que el negocio ya produce. Construcción real: prototipar con LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes y workflows, automatización low-code y SQL. Probar valor en alcance acotado antes de pedir inversión de plataforma. Kraken: evolucionar el outreach automatizado de recordatorios por reglas a agentes capaces de sostener una conversación y resolver la tarea sin escalar a una persona. Instrumentación: definir qué significa éxito en cada campaña automatizada y cerrar la brecha de conversaciones sin evaluación de resultado. Escalamiento: llevar los prototipos a sistemas soportados junto con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations y equipos globales. Build vs. buy: evaluar proveedores cuando comprar gana a construir, y decirlo con claridad cuando no. Adopción real: responder por el uso diario de las herramientas por parte de CS, el equipo de upsell y los Key Account Managers — no por los lanzamientos. Governance de IA: definir qué puede decidir un modelo solo, qué debe escuchar un doctor de una persona, y bajo qué criterios se construye, compra o mata una iniciativa. Privacidad de datos: garantizar que ningún dato personal o clínico entre a prompts, logs o sistemas de terceros sin base legal y revisión documentada. Liderazgo: dirigir y hacer crecer a tu equipo; presentar resultados, hipótesis y apuestas fallidas a leadership local y de grupo en números claros. Lo que buscamos Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones comerciales, Customer Success, Service Operations o Revenue Operations, en un negocio de suscripción o marketplace. Al menos 2 años liderando equipo directo. Experiencia comprobable construyendo con IA —no solo usándola—: LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes o workflows, diseño de prompts y de evaluación, con sistemas en producción e impacto medible. Inglés Avanzado Capacidad de leer un P&L y defender una línea de presupuesto ante Finanzas. Experiencia gestionando proyectos multifuncionales con stakeholders más senior, sin autoridad formal sobre ellos. Deseable: experiencia en SaaS, marketplace o salud. ¿Te interesa construir el modelo operativo de CS de una de las plataformas de salud más grandes de Latinoamérica? Postúlate o comparte esta vacante con alguien que encaje. 🚀
